## Arithmetic partial sums {#ss4-formulas .ar-lesson .ar-formulas-slide}

::: {.split .ar-formula-sheet-layout}
::: {.column-block .ar-formula-summary}
$$S_n=\sum\limits_{k=1}^{n}a_k$$

<h3>First and last terms known</h3>

$$S_n=\frac{n}{2}(a+a_n)$$

<h3>First term and difference known</h3>

$$S_n=\frac{n}{2}[2a+(n-1)d]$$

<p class="ar-mean-interpretation">Number of terms × average of the first and last terms.</p>

:::
::: {.column-block .ar-reference-full}

Here a is the first term and a_n=l is the last term included in S_n. The number of terms is n when the sum starts at index 1. Choose either form according to the information supplied.
